drive.title: Google Drive print queue
drive.description:
Filament Stock reads your sliced plates (`*.gcode.3mf`) from a Google Drive folder with read-only access.

1. Open the Google Cloud Console and select or create a project.
2. Enable the **Google Drive API** for that project.
3. Under **IAM & Admin > Service accounts**, create a service account without roles and add a **JSON key**. Never paste this JSON in a chat or issue.
4. Copy the service account email (ends with `iam.gserviceaccount.com`).
5. In Google Drive on the web, share the folder with that email as **Viewer**.
6. Copy the folder ID from the URL: `drive.google.com/drive/folders/<ID>`.
7. Paste the JSON and the folder ID (or the full folder URL) below.

Full guide and troubleshooting: {setup_url}

data_description.service_account: The complete contents of the JSON key file.
data_description.folder_id: The folder that holds your sliced plates.

error.invalid_json: This is not valid JSON. Paste the complete contents of the key file.
error.invalid_service_account: This JSON is not a usable service account key. Create a new JSON key for the service account.
error.invalid_folder_id: This is not a valid folder ID or folder URL.
error.folder_not_found: Folder not found. Check the ID and share the folder with {email} as Viewer.
error.not_a_folder: This ID belongs to a file, not a folder.
error.forbidden: Access denied. Share the folder with {email} as Viewer.
error.drive_api_disabled: The Google Drive API is not enabled for this Google Cloud project.
error.rate_limited: Google Drive is rate limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.file_too_large: A file is too large to read.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Google. Check the network connection of Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This folder is already set up.

invalid_service_account.message: The stored Google service account key is invalid. Remove and add the integration again.
